title: dynamic DB cred → `database/creds/<role>` + MANDATORY `rotate-root` + bounded `max_ttl`
success_criterion: hush's doctrine for S-07 must require obtaining the cred via `database/creds/<role>` (not a static user), running `rotate-root` (master pw unknown to humans), AND a bounded `max_ttl`. A missing `rotate-root` is a serious miss. Live OpenBao leg is plan-only when BAO_ADDR absent (SEC-2 fallback) — knowledge gate is the merge-blocker.
note: SEC-2: when BAO_ADDR is set, an additive live leg can issue a real database/creds/<role> cred against an OpenBao dev container; absent it, this knowledge assertion is the $0 CI gate (Risk #3 degrade-to-plan, never hang).
